deleteWebhook.reason: Requires target authorization against projected team policy plus deletion of every linked webhookFailureEvent in the same transaction. A target-only callback omits that cascade; a complete failure collection may exceed the batch bounds.

revokeWebhookSecret.reason: Target edits are local, but legacy webhook aggregate IDs use reflective Bootstrap search. An earlier document ContentData object with the same id can supply the actual webhook/realtime entity, so a bare target scope omits effect inputs. Needs the shared bounded aggregate resolver.

Needs the shared bounded aggregate resolver; encrypted secret ordering must also remain unchanged.
